# Kubert AI Assistant Lite

> Kubert AI Assistant Lite is an open-source DevOps productivity tool that deploys a local Kubernetes cluster using kind (Kubernetes in Docker) with an AI-powered Kubectl Agent for automating cluster management through natural language prompts.

## Project Overview

Kubert AI Assistant Lite simplifies Kubernetes management by combining generative AI with Kubernetes tooling. It provides a local development environment where developers can interact with their Kubernetes cluster using natural language instead of memorizing kubectl commands.

The project is maintained by Patryk Golabek and is released under the MIT License.

- Source Code: https://github.com/TranslucentComputing/kubert-assistant-lite
- Documentation: {{ site.url }}/
- Community: https://discord.gg/d22b58ejgV

## Key Features

- **Local Kubernetes Cluster**: Deploys a kind cluster inside Docker for local development and testing
- **AI-Powered Kubectl Agent**: Executes kubectl commands based on natural language prompts
- **Multi-LLM Support**: Works with OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Groq, Google AI, and local Ollama models
- **Automated Diagnostics**: Identifies and helps fix resource misconfigurations in Kubernetes
- **Helm-Based Deployment**: Uses Helm charts for easy deployment and configuration
- **BATS Testing**: Comprehensive unit and integration testing with BATS framework

## Architecture

The system consists of:
1. Developer's Machine running Docker
2. kind Cluster (Kubernetes in Docker)
3. Kubert Assistant management layer
4. Kubectl AI Agent for command execution
5. LobeChat UI for user interaction

## Prerequisites

- Docker
- kind (Kubernetes in Docker)
- Helm
- kubectl
- jq
- Make
- An API key from OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, or Google AI (or local Ollama)

## Quick Start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/TranslucentComputing/kubert-assistant-lite.git
cd kubert-assistant-lite
make deploy
```

Then open http://kubert-assistant.lan/ in your browser.

## Technologies

Kubernetes, Docker, kind, Helm, BATS, kcov, OpenAI API, Anthropic API, Groq API, Google AI API, Ollama, LobeChat, Calico, NGINX Ingress Controller
